description: Add Windows build job to CI: windows-latest runner, install Rust + MSVC toolchain, cargo build the helper, npm install + electron-builder for Windows targets. Run clippy and cargo test on Windows. Cache cargo registry and target/ for build speed. Matrix: x64 only initially. Produce artifacts: Setup.exe (NSIS), Portable.exe, and helper .exe with sha256 sidecars.
title: Windows CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)
